name: Quantifiers (some / any / much / many …)
note: some in positives and offers/requests; any in negatives and questions. much + uncountable, many + plural countable (both mostly in negatives/questions); a lot of works everywhere. a few + countable, a little + uncountable = a small positive amount.

questions.q: How ______ time do you have left before you have to go to school?
questions.fs: How much time do you have left before you have to go to school?

questions.q: I love coffee in the morning, but I only take a ______ milk and two teaspoons of sugar in it.
questions.fs: I love coffee in the morning, but I only take a little milk and two teaspoons of sugar in it.

questions.q: How many gallons of water did you bring for the trip??? I just have ______ gallons.
questions.fs: How many gallons of water did you bring for the trip??? I just have a few gallons.

questions.q: My boss is very particular about everything, and he has very ______ tolerance for silly mistakes.
questions.fs: My boss is very particular about everything, and he has very little tolerance for silly mistakes.

questions.q: He hasn't bought ______ oranges.
Do you want ______ more potato chips? There's another bag in the cupboard if you do.
questions.fs: Do you want some more potato chips? There's another bag in the cupboard if you do.

questions.q: There are ______ people on the street.
I can't go right now because I still have a ______ orders to fill by 5 o'clock.
questions.fs: I can't go right now because I still have a few orders to fill by 5 o'clock.

questions.q: How ______ does the book cost?
questions.fs: How much does the book cost?

questions.q: Despite their marketing efforts, the promoters only managed to sell a ______ CDs for the band this past year.
questions.fs: Despite their marketing efforts, the promoters only managed to sell a few CDs for the band this past year.

questions.q: Do you have ______ ants in your house?
questions.fs: Do you have many ants in your house?

questions.q: Would you like some more coffee? There's still ______ left.
No, I don't. But I have ______ apples, if you'd like to make apple juice instead.
questions.fs: No, I don't. But I have some apples, if you'd like to make apple juice instead.

questions.q: Would you like ______ cream in your coffee?
questions.fs: Would you like some cream in your coffee?

questions.q: Jessica spent a lot of money on her car. Now she only has ______ money left to pay for her living expenses.
questions.fs: Jessica spent a lot of money on her car. Now she only has a little money left to pay for her living expenses.

questions.q: I've brought you ______ flowers for your birthday.
You are ______ smart.
questions.fs: You are very smart.

questions.q: I love Thailand. I've already been there a ______ times and I plan to go back this summer.
questions.fs: I love Thailand. I've already been there a few times and I plan to go back this summer.

questions.q: I've put ______ water in the bottles.
This meal is so good! Do you think I could have a ______ more beef, please?
questions.fs: This meal is so good! Do you think I could have a little more beef, please?

questions.q: I have ______ of friends.
questions.fs: I have lots of friends.

questions.q: I need a ______ help with my homework. Do you have time to help me?
questions.fs: I need a little help with my homework. Do you have time to help me?

questions.q: I only have ______ dollars.
questions.fs: I only have a few dollars.

questions.q: Since I started my new job, it seems like I've got very ______ time to do the things I enjoy.
questions.fs: Since I started my new job, it seems like I've got very little time to do the things I enjoy.

questions.q: I need to practice piano ______ before the concert.
questions.fs: I need to practice piano a lot before the concert.

questions.q: Do you need ______ milk for this recipe?
questions.fs: Do you need much milk for this recipe?

questions.q: Wow! Look at that! How ______ books do you have on your shelves? I have to tell you it's a great collection!
questions.fs: Wow! Look at that! How many books do you have on your shelves? I have to tell you it's a great collection!

questions.q: How ______ water do you drink every day?
questions.fs: How much water do you drink every day?

questions.q: I want to make orange juice. Have you got ______ oranges?
questions.fs: I want to make orange juice. Have you got any oranges?

questions.q: How ______ people are coming?
questions.fs: How many people are coming?

questions.q: There are ______ people trying to go to the U2 concert this weekend.
questions.fs: There are many people trying to go to the U2 concert this weekend.

questions.q: I have ______ of homework to do before tomorrow.
questions.fs: I have a ton of homework to do before tomorrow.

questions.q: How ______ money do you have?
questions.fs: How much money do you have?

questions.q: They bought ______ bread.
Would you like ______ juice?
questions.fs: Would you like some juice?

questions.q: You are a ______ honest person.
questions.fs: You are a very honest person.
